summary: Saudi Arabia conducted airstrikes on Sana'a International Airport to prevent an Iranian aircraft from landing, prompting Houthi threats of retaliation. Iran reported multiple explosions in Bandar Abbas and Qeshm, while reports indicate Iranian missiles were launched toward Arab countries. The UK has officially proscribed the IRGC as a terrorist organization.
key_points: Saudi Arabia struck the runway at Sana'a International Airport to block an Iranian aircraft landing, ending the de-escalation phase (Source: @yediotnews25/132598).
Four missiles were launched from the Chamran base in Jam toward the Persian Gulf at 05:20 on July 22 (Source: @mamlekate/103876).
The governor of Qeshm reported 10 to 11 enemy projectiles hit military targets on Qeshm Island (Source: @VahidOnline/76967).
The Iranian Army claimed to have downed a hostile US drone over Bandar Abbas using an integrated air defense network (Source: @presstv/198499).
The UK government has proscribed the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organization (Source: @shin_persian/7775).
The IDF eliminated Mustafa Oweizi, a smuggler attempting to bring military equipment into the Gaza Strip for Hamas (Source: @idf_telegram/24618).
Sirens sounded in Bahrain following reported missile launches from Iran (Source: @inon_yttach/9406).
Former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is reportedly under house arrest by the IRGC for alleged contacts with Israel (Source: @asafroz/51362).

sections.executive_summary: Saudi airstrikes on Sana'a International Airport have triggered a sharp escalation with Houthi threats of retaliation and a declared end to the ceasefire. Simultaneous reports of missile launches from Iran toward Arab countries and strikes on Qeshm Island indicate a widening regional conflict. The diplomatic environment has deteriorated further with the UK's proscription of the IRGC and US threats regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

points: Four missiles were launched from the Chamran base in Jam at 05:20 on July 22 toward the Persian Gulf (Source: @mamlekate/103876).
Governor Hussein Amir Timouri reported 10 to 11 enemy projectiles hitting military targets on Qeshm Island with no casualties reported (Source: @VahidOnline/76967).
The Iranian Army reported the downing of a hostile US drone over Bandar Abbas using a new integrated air defense network (Source: @presstv/198499).
Reports indicate multiple explosions in Bandar Abbas and Ahvaz, with specific reports of seven explosions in Dezful and attacks on the Fourth Fighter Base (Source: @mamlekate/103875).
GPS disruptions were reported in several areas of Tehran on Monday, July 22, affecting navigation apps and internet taxis (Source: @kianmeli1/88912).
Former President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is reportedly under house arrest by the IRGC following allegations of contact with the Mossad (Source: @almogboker78/17707).
The IDF eliminated Mustafa Oweizi in southern Gaza, who was smuggling military equipment for Hamas's maritime and aerial capabilities (Source: @idf_telegram/24618).
The IDF highlighted the discovery of massive Iranian-built tunnels beneath the strategic Beaufort fortress overlooking Metula (Source: @inon_yttach/9408).
The IDF commemorated the 20th anniversary of the Second Lebanon War, noting 34 days of fighting (Source: @idf_telegram/24605).
The IDF's Home Front Command expert mission continued stability assessments and rescue operations in Venezuela (Source: @idf_telegram/24607).
The IDF eliminated smuggler Mustafa Oweizi in southern Gaza who was attempting to restore Hamas's military wing (Source: @idf_telegram/24618).
Reports indicate an attack occurred in Gaza, though specific targets were not detailed (Source: @lelotsenzura/93547).
Warplanes were reported flying toward the Beqaa Valley, with warnings for maximum caution issued (Source: @redlinkleb/31139).
Artillery shelling was reported in Kfar Tibnit (Source: @redlinkleb/31172).
Reports indicate aircraft activity over Zalaya and Al-Ahmediya (Source: @redlinkleb/31082).
An explosion was reported in the Diyala province of eastern Iraq (Source: @lelotsenzura/93536).
Commemorations were held for commanders Abu Muntazar al-Muhamadawi and Abu Habib al-Sukini (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376907).
Saudi Arabia struck the runway at Sana'a International Airport to prevent an Iranian aircraft from landing (Source: @yediotnews25/132598).
The Houthi-run Foreign Ministry declared the Saudi strike as the end of the de-escalation and ceasefire phase (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4914).
Sirens sounded in Bahrain following reports of direct impacts and visible smoke from a distance (Source: @VahidOnline/76988).
Kepler reported only six ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, the lowest number in five weeks (Source: @kianmeli1/88913).
Donald Trump stated that the US intends to take control of the Strait of Hormuz, calling Iranian leaders a 'group of bad people' (Source: @yediotnews25/132599).

The UK government officially proscribed the IRGC as a terrorist organization (Source: @shin_persian/7775).
10 to 11 enemy projectiles struck military targets on Qeshm Island, Iran (Source: @VahidOnline/76967).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation is highly volatile due to direct kinetic exchanges between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces, coupled with Iranian missile activity toward the Gulf. The IRGC's claim of sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and US threats to seize control increase the risk of a maritime blockade. The proscription of the IRGC by the UK signals a shift toward more aggressive diplomatic and legal targeting of Iranian state organs.
sections.regional_response: Houthi forces have threatened 'heavy consequences' and attacks on Saudi airports and vital interests in response to the Sana'a strike. Bahrain has activated emergency sirens, indicating a state of high alert against Iranian missile threats. The Yemeni government (anti-Houthi) issued evacuation warnings for the area surrounding Sana'a Airport.
sections.intelligence_notes: The timing of the Saudi strike immediately following an Iranian aircraft landing suggests a strict enforcement of the blockade on Sana'a. The reported GPS disruptions in Tehran may indicate electronic warfare activity coinciding with the regional missile launches. The reported house arrest of Mahmoud Ahmadinejad suggests internal IRGC purges related to suspected Israeli intelligence penetration.
